# www.samtelavionics.com

> Samtel Avionics designs and manufactures avionics, displays, electro-optic and electronic warfare systems for defence and railways in India.


## Home

- [Defence Electronics Company in India | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/): Samtel Avionics designs and manufactures avionics, displays, electro-optic and electronic warfare systems for defence and railways in India.

## Industries

- [Industries We Serve: Defence, Rail, Space | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/industries): Seven domains: airborne, naval, land, space and satellite, unmanned, railway and emerging tech. Avionics and electronics for mission-critical platforms.

## Company overview

- [About Samtel Avionics | Company Profile & Capabilities | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/company-overview): 50+ years, 100+ products designed, 1M+ flying hours. Samtel Avionics delivers design, manufacturing, MRO and lifecycle support for mission-critical electronics.

## Our journey milestones

- [Our Journey & Milestones | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/our-journey-milestones): From India's first private picture tube plant in 1973 to avionics, HAL and Thales joint ventures, railways and space: five decades of Samtel's growth.

## Certifications quality

- [ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, CEMILAC Approvals | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/certifications-quality): Samtel Avionics holds ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D, is a CEMILAC-approved design house with a DGAQA-approved facility, and has RDSO-approved railway DDUs.

## Global partnerships collaborations and key customers

- [Global Partners & Key Customers | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/global-partnerships-collaborations-and-key-customers): Works with HAL, DRDO, Bharat Electronics, Indian Railways, Honeywell, Thales, BAE Systems, HENSOLDT, Siemens and ALSTOM across defence, aerospace and rail.

## Overview

- [What We Do: Mission-Critical Electronics | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/overview): Samtel designs, manufactures and sustains avionics, displays, rugged electronics, optronics, space payloads, UAVs, railway electronics and test benches.

## Engineering design

- [Avionics & Display Systems: HUD, MFD | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/avionics-display-systems): Cockpit displays and airborne electronics: multi-function and head-up displays, standby instruments and mission computers for aircraft.
- [Optronics: EO/IR, Gimbals & Video Trackers | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/optronics): EO/IR imaging, tracking and stabilization: gimbals, video trackers, motion controllers and camera electronics for surveillance and Counter-UAS.
- [Rugged Electronics Engineering | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/rugged-electronics): High-reliability electronics for harsh environments: embedded processing, power electronics, thermal and mechanical design and lifecycle support.
- [Railway Electronics Engineering | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/railway-electronics): Build-to-spec design, ruggedized build-to-print manufacturing and lifecycle support for rail electronics on rolling stock that runs 30 to 40 years.
- [UAV Engineering & Integration | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/uavs): UAV systems for defence, homeland security and infrastructure surveillance: propulsion, avionics, navigation, data links and flight testing support.
- [Test Benches & Automated Test Equipment | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/test-benches): Custom test benches and ATE for avionics, displays, optronics and railway systems, covering production acceptance, fault isolation and depot-level sustainment.
- [Space & Satellite Engineering | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design/space-satellite-systems): RF, embedded and mission-critical communications for satellite payloads, gateways and user terminals, with thermal vacuum and EMC/EMI qualification testing.
- [Engineering & Design Services | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/engineering-design): 100+ products designed in five decades: requirements analysis, electronics, embedded software, FPGA, optical and mechanical design, EMI/EMC and qualification.

## Sustainability csr

- [Sustainability & CSR | Education Focus | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/sustainability-csr): Samtel Avionics' CSR centres on education: nearly four decades of support through the Modern Public School Society, serving 5,000+ students in North India.

## Manufacturing

- [Manufacturing | High-Mix, Low-Volume Electronics | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/manufacturing): Display manufacturing with optical bonding, electronics assembly, cable harness and box build for high-reliability, low-volume, high-mix programs.

## Mro repair and lifecycle support

- [MRO & Obsolescence Management | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/mro-repair-and-lifecycle-support): Depot-level maintenance, failure analysis, DMSMS management, reverse engineering and form-fit-function replacements to extend mission-critical system life.

## Category

- [Airborne Avionics: MFD, HUD & ISIS | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/airborne-solutions): Multifunction displays, head-up displays, ISIS and mission computers for Su-30 MKI, Mirage 2000 MLU, LCH, ALH, LUH and IJT. Type approved, combat proven.
- [Naval Displays & Electronics Solutions | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/naval-solutions): Command console, surveillance and mission displays with rugged maritime electronics and naval EO/IR systems, from design to lifecycle support.
- [Space-Based IoT, AIS & ADS-B Services | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/space-satellite-systems): Satellite IoT/MSS, AIS, ADS-B and ISL payload services over a LEO constellation with AES-256 encryption, plus space debris management services.
- [Railway Electronics: DDU, TCMS, PIS & JRU | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/railway-electronics): Driver display units, centralized control and monitoring, PIS/PA, event recorders and remote diagnostics for Vande Bharat, metros and locomotives.
- [Rugged Displays & SIGINT for Land Systems | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/land-solutions): Rugged displays from 7 to 24 inch, combat vehicle display solutions and NETRA-SAMTEL, an indigenous DMR-based SIGINT system, for land platforms.
- [Unmanned Solutions | UAVs & Loitering Munitions | Samtel | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/unmanned-solutions): Mini UAVs, long-range ISR drones, loitering munitions and heavy-lift logistics drones, supporting India's indigenous defence goals and lower import reliance.
- [Industrial & Emerging Technologies | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/category/industrial-emerging-technologies): High-reliability electronic and optronic solutions for industrial and emerging technology domains, from embedded systems to collaborative co-development.

- [Manufacturing Facilities | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/manufacturing-facilities): Controlled facilities for optical bonding, cleanroom work, box build, production testing, first-article inspection and repair across defence and rail programs.

- [Design & R&D Facilities | Samtel Avionics | Samtel Avionics](https://www.samtelavionics.com/design-rd-facilities): Electronics and optical labs, Class 1000 cleanrooms and rapid prototyping with ARAS Innovator, Zemax and MATLAB, behind 100+ products over five decades.
